messages:
lydia: quick heads-up: rerank-cx3 int8 PTQ bringup shows ndcg@10 +0.3% but MRR -6.5% on short-title slice. looks similar to past tokenization/markup issues. anyone free to triage?
enzo: can you paste an example query and top3 candidates where top1 changed?
lydia: example qid=77: 
  q: "best wireless earbuds"
  baseline top3: ["BrandA Model X", "BrandB Pro", "BrandC Mini"]
  candidate top3: ["BrandB Pro", "BrandA Model X", "BrandC Mini"]
  candidate score diff: head compressed by ~0.12 logits
priya: did we change snippet ingest? we had a small preserve-markup toggle rolled for snippet emphasis last week.
enzo: that matches known failure modes: markup adds <em> tags which create subtoken boundaries and can change logits, esp after PTQ. do we have calibration examples with markup?
lydia: PTQ calibration used corpus drawn from prod-snapshot-2026-03-01 which had html-stripped pipeline. so candidate pipeline mismatch is likely.
priya: quick experiment: run the eval harness with two variants: (A) emulate prod-candidate pipeline (markup preserved) but use baseline fp16; (B) preserve markup + int8. see deltas.
eval-bot: experiment results (N=3k short-title slice):
  - baseline(fp16, markup-stripped): ndcg@10=0.512, mrr=0.384
  - fp16 with markup-preserved: ndcg@10=0.514, mrr=0.383
  - int8 with markup-preserved: ndcg@10=0.515, mrr=0.359
priya: again we see marginal ndcg gain but MRR head drop only when int8 present.
enzo: mitigation options: 1) canonicalize snippet to strip markup on canary until we recalibrate, 2) augment PTQ calibration corpus with markup-preserved examples and re-run calibrate job, 3) add a parity gate in onboarding that forces candidate ingest config match calibration config.
lydia: I'd prefer augmenting calibration corpus but faster is canonicalize canary. we should also add a CI check that compares top1 overlap for golden-short-title set and fails if >1.5% regression.
priya: i'll queue a recalibration job with markup-preserved samples: calib-1799-markup. enzo: can you add the parity check to the harness?
enzo: on it. small helper script I'll add to harness: ```python
# compute top1 overlap
def top1_overlap(baseline_scores, candidate_scores):
    bl_top1 = [argmax(s) for s in baseline_scores]
    cand_top1 = [argmax(s) for s in candidate_scores]
    return mean([b==c for b,c in zip(bl_top1, cand_top1)])
```
lydia: also log tie_count and tie_fraction so we can see if PTQ increases ties.
eval-bot: queued: calib-1799-markup (priority medium), harness-parity-check pr opened by enzo.
priya: ops ticket INF-9102 created to canonicalize canary ingest to markup-stripped until recalib completes.
lydia: thanks all. once calib finishes let's rerun the microbench and decide whether to flip canary. :thumbsup:
